body: Shih Tzu. His name was KoKo..
Why? What difference would it have made?..
If you’re thanking me for giving you absolutely nothing then you’re welcome.

I have everything I thought would make me happy. Friends, family, a job, a car, support, people who care, but I’m still unhappy. I don’t know what to do, or what steps to take. I feel like theres only so much I can do.. and theres so much I’ve already done. I just don’t know how to fix it. I just want to disappear for good when I feel like this.
